name: Power Infrastructure System
summary: Dual-utility 33kV/11kV grid inputs, transformer step-down, synchronized generator bus, static transfer, and 2N UPS trains feeding server racks.
mermaid:
graph TD
  Grid1[Utility Feeder A 33kV] --> HT1[HT Switchgear 11kV A]
  Grid2[Utility Feeder B 33kV] --> HT2[HT Switchgear 11kV B]
  HT1 --> XFR1[Transformer 1 2500kVA]
  HT2 --> XFR2[Transformer 2 2500kVA]
  DG1[Diesel Gen 1 2500kVA] --> Sync[Sync Panel]
  DG2[Diesel Gen 2 2500kVA] --> Sync
  XFR1 --> ATS1[ATS A]
  XFR2 --> ATS2[ATS B]
  Sync -.-> ATS1
  Sync -.-> ATS2
  ATS1 --> UPSA[UPS Train A 1500kVA]
  ATS2 --> UPSB[UPS Train B 1500kVA]
  UPSA --> PDUA[Rack PDU A-Side]
  UPSB --> PDUB[Rack PDU B-Side]
  PDUA --> Server[Critical Dual-Cord IT Server]
  PDUB --> Server

stages.detail: Redundant 33kV power feeds stepped to 11kV at the intake substation.
Dual-bus 11kV vacuum switchgear with protective relaying.
Cast-resin 2500kVA dry transformers reducing voltage to 415V/240V.
4x 2500kVA synchronized Cummins diesel gensets taking full load within 12 seconds.
Modular UPS trains running in 2N configuration guaranteeing clean sine wave.
Intelligent A+B busway and rack PDUs feeding redundant enterprise dual-cord power supplies.

name: HVAC & Precision Cooling System
summary: Water-cooled centrifugal chiller plant with plate heat exchanger economizer, secondary pumped chilled water loops, and In-Row PAC units with Cold-Aisle Containment.
mermaid:
graph TD
  Chiller[Water-Cooled Chiller 450TR] --> PrimPump[Primary Pump Loop]
  PrimPump --> SecPump[Secondary VFD Pumps]
  SecPump --> Ring[Dual-Ring Chilled Water Header]
  Ring --> PAC1[In-Row Cooler Pod 1]
  Ring --> PAC2[In-Row Cooler Pod 2]
  Ring --> PAC3[In-Row Cooler Pod 3]
  PAC1 --> ColdAisle[Cold Aisle Containment 22°C]
  ColdAisle --> Rack[Server Equipment]
  Rack --> HotAisle[Hot Aisle Return 35°C]
  HotAisle --> PAC1

stages.detail: Centrifugal chillers maintain 7°C supply with 13°C return loops.
VFD-controlled secondary pumps adjust flow based on aisle differential pressure.
In-Row precision air units blow cold air horizontally directly in front of IT intakes.
Physical roof and sliding doors isolate supply cold air from heated server exhaust air.

name: Fire Detection & Suppression System
summary: Multi-stage defense employing aspirating smoke detection (VESDA) for early warnings, cross-zoned smoke detectors, and FK-5-1-12 clean agent gaseous flooding.
mermaid:
graph TD
  VESDA[Aspirating Smoke Detector] --> Alert1[Level 1: NOC Pre-Alarm Alert]
  DetA[Smoke Detector Zone A] --> CrossCheck{Dual Zone Coincidence?}
  DetB[Smoke Detector Zone B] --> CrossCheck
  CrossCheck -- Yes --> Timer[30s Evacuation Countdown & Sirens]
  Timer --> Actuate[Release FK-5-1-12 Clean Agent Gas]
  Actuate --> RoomExtinguish[Total Flooding Extinguishment without water]
  CrossCheck -- No --> Alert2[Visual Annunciator Warning]

stages.detail: Continuous active air drawing via VESDA pipe network detects particles at incipient combustion.
Two independent optical/ionization detector loops must trigger to arm gas discharge.
30-second warning sirens sound while HVAC dampers automatically snap shut.
Clean agent discharges in under 10 seconds, eliminating oxygen-free combustion while remaining non-toxic to humans.
